title: Unforgettable visit
text:
History and art.
Magistrally guided by Jose Esturillo was a journey to other times.
They are monuments that invite to reflection on what characterizes us as creators of Beauty
author: R6185BEcristinaf

title: Best tour.
text: One of the best conducted tour that I have undertaken. On our tour day the temperature was very high. Emilio, our tour guide maintained a very good balance between the pace of the tour and providing rest opportunities as the group consisted of various age groups. His knowledge of Alhambra's history and his explanation of various questions put to him was exceptional.
author: 351shahabn

title: Great palace, even better tour
text: We were fools who didn't book ahead of time so we're very happy when we were able to get in with the tour, even happier to find out the tour was the best part of it! Emilio had answers to every question you threw at him. He pointed out details you'd otherwise miss and added history and knowledge that made you appreciate what you saw even more. Bonus was he also knew all the good photo spots and had great tapas recommendations!! Would really recommend.
author: 828tullym

title: Emilio! Best guided tour I’ve done
text: We did this trip on a hot day but our lovely guide Emilio took as on a great path to see the best of the Alhambra with breaks in the shade. Emilio was very charming and had wonderful information on all aspects of the tour and very happy to answer any questions we had. The tour also felt personal as Emilio is a local and a his love for Alhambra is abundant! Highly recommend :)
author: pippam822

title: Great visit with great guide!!
text: Great visit with great guide. Our guide Emilio was very kind, well organized and very knowledgeable. I recommend him 100%.
